RESOLVED: Dear Ms. Whitfield,

Re: Claim CLM-550193 for brain MRI on August 27

Thank you for reaching out to us about the denial of your claim. I apologize for any inconvenience this has caused. The denial reason was "prior authorization not on file". I understand that your doctor ordered the MRI for your migraines.

You have the right to appeal this decision. You may file a first-level appeal within 180 days of the denial notice date. Your ordering provider, Dr. Okonjo, may submit a retrospective authorization request with clinical documentation supporting medical necessity.

The exact deadline for your appeal is 180 days from the denial notice date. I have attached the appeal form (FORM-APP-1) to this response for your convenience. If you have any questions or need help with the appeal process, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.

We will decide on standard appeals within 30 calendar days. Please let us know if you need any further assistance.

Sincerely,
ARIA
Meridian Health Plan 

Note: The appeal form (FORM-APP-1) is attached to this email for your reference.
